text:
anya: Quick sync from today's RFC follow-up: we need a pragmatic settlement API that handles late-arrivals without confusing customers.
miguel: Problem statement: ingest emits per-token events and sometimes we re-attribute after fixes. Customers want a stable bill and an auditable trail.
sam: Option 1: expose a finalized "settlement" per-window (daily/month) and surface an adjustments feed for any later changes. Option 2: stream raw events and force customers to assemble their own windows.
julia: For most accounting teams Option 1 is way easier. They need a number to lock on. But we mustn't hide the re-attributions.
kevin: Agreed. We should treat the settlement as the product contract: a settlement has a status and an immutable list of adjustments.
ash: +1. Also call out types of adjustments: CORRECTION, SPLIT, MERGE, REVERSAL, and BACKFILL. Each adjustment must reference the source event ids and a human reason.
metering-bot: FYI: staging conflict rate 0.018% last 30 days when same event_id had mismatched fingerprints.
anya: Important design points I want captured: (a) canonical event id must be our primary diff key; (b) fingerprint used to detect content changes; (c) provenance handle must point to ledger://region/stream/offset.
miguel: sample event we can include in RFC (compact):
```
event_id: uuid-1234
fp: sha256-abcd
tenant: t-001
tokens: 320
ingest_ts: 1717001000
billing_ts: 1716990000
provenance: ledger://us-west/usage/00012345
```
julia: UX: settlement response should include "net_amount", "net_tokens", "status" (PROVISIONAL|FINAL), "adjustment_summary" and an "adjustments_stream_url" for full detail. Keep first page inline for quick eyeballing.
sam: Pagination note: adjustments_stream must support cursor-based pages, include total_estimate and be fast (<300ms first page).
kevin: Finality model: provisional -> locked -> final. Default provisional window TTL 72h, but allow tenant override (up to 30 days) for enterprise. After final, adjustments are still allowed but must be explicit and visible.
anya: How do we represent late-attribution in the invoice? Proposal: show original line item + appended adjustment rows. Each adjustment row has: adj_id, type, delta_tokens, delta_amount, reason, provenance_ptrs[].
miguel: We should also add an "audit_summary" hash for the settlement that accountants can verify. E.g., settlement_hash = sha256(sorted(event_ids + adjustments)).
ash: Security: adjustments_stream must enforce tenant scoping and redact PII by default. Raw prompt text only available on explicit opt-in and enterprise contracts.
sam: Implementation detail: ledger remains append-only. Finalizer computes incremental deltas by comparing event_id -> fingerprint mapping between runs to avoid full rehydrate.
julia: Backfill behaviour: if a backfill touches a closed settlement window, we create adjustment records referencing the backfill job id, not mutate old lines. That keeps audit trails clean.
kevin: Retention: raw provenance retention default 90 days; enterprise configurable. Adjustments and settlements retained indefinitely (for accounting).
anya: Question: big tenants may see thousands of adjustments for a month after a major fix. We should offer a compressed view: grouped by reason/model/route with roll-up totals. Also allow download as CSV/PARQUET for audits.
miguel: agree. Add throttling and streaming ACLs for adjustments export to protect infra.
sam: Operational alarm: surface conflict events (event_id with differing fingerprints) to the ingest team channel and attach a sample payload. Make conflict rate a PagerDuty alert if >0.1% sustained.
metering-bot: ACTION: emit conflict-summaries once/day to #eng-platform; include sample count and top 5 tenants.
anya: Action items from this thread:
- Draft settlement API proto + example responses (sam + miguel)  due Wed COB.
- Finality config RFC (product + infra)  draft by next Tue.
- Adjustments stream contract + pagination spec (anya + eng-platform)  spike this week.
- Ingest idempotency conflict surfacing (ingest)  include alert thresholds.
- Audit export support (platform + jd)  prototype month-end export.
kevin: Can we add a small example adjustment record in the RFC? helps auditors see fields.
julia: yes include: adj_id, related_event_ids[], delta_tokens, delta_amount_cents, type, reason, prov_ptrs[], created_by, created_ts.
anya: I'll assemble the follow-up RFC with those examples and post a PR. Tag me and @kevin for review.
miguel: thanks everyone. small ask: include a short migration plan for existing invoices so accounting sees continuity.
sam: noted. I'll add a compatibility shim that returns identical numbers for current customers for 6 months post-launch.
anya: perfect. Closing thread, will post RFC link here when ready.
